Soul Allegiance

Soul Allegiance light up every dance floor with feel-good party anthems, killer vocals, and a soulful setlist that keeps every generation grooving all night.

About Soul Allegiance

Soul Allegiance are a feel-good, floor-filling 6-piece band serving up Motown magic , RnB grooves , and pop bangers that bring guests of all ages together. With two sensational female vocalists , keys, guitar, bass, and drums, their sound is both slick and soulful , perfect for weddings, joint birthdays, and big family celebrations. Fronted by the dynamic duo Kedesha and Emma-May , the band’s energy is infectious . Kedesha’s voice is smooth, rich, and steeped in RnB, while Emma-May’s powerful, honeyed tone channels soul legends like Aretha Franklin and Diana Ross . Together, they have undeniable chemistry and effortlessly lift the room. Backed by a rock-solid rhythm section , these pro musicians have performed at Glastonbury, Notting Hill Carnival, Jazz Café, and SXSW , and supported names like Robbie Williams, Emeli Sande , and Rudimental . They’re well-rehearsed, polished , and a total joy to watch . With a repertoire of 400+ songs , Soul Allegiance let you tailor your setlist, request special songs, and even add live brass or Israeli dancing sets . Expect excellent communication, great vibes , and top-tier musicianship from the first enquiry to the final encore.
